name: America In The End Times
overview: Scripture reveals that in the end times, God’s sovereign plan unfolds with the coming of new heavens and a new earth, where former things will be forgotten (Isaiah 65:17). Believers are called to fear and serve the LORD alone (Deuteronomy 6:13), trusting in the promise of eternal life through faith in Jesus Christ (John 3:16). The prophetic visions, such as those in Daniel and Ezekiel, remind us that earthly powers will rise and fall under God's authority (Daniel 7:4; Ezekiel 38:1), and that the day of the Son of Man’s revelation will be sudden and decisive (Luke 17:30). This calls the church to steadfast faithfulness amid the unfolding end-time events.
